verdict.rationale: Slate ships as an official, globally installable terminal CLI (`npm i -g @randomlabs/slate`). Its first-party docs cover onboarding, a TUI with slash commands (/sessions, /workspace, /bug-report), shell execution with `!`, hotkeys, and command-line flags such as `--dangerously-skip-permissions`/`--yolo`. A probe also confirms the official CLI is documented at the quickstart. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI experience, since the community evidence does not address the CLI itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: We support `--dangerously-skip-permissions` (alias: `--yolo`) to bypass permission prompts.
The `/bug-report` command lets you submit a bug report directly from the TUI.
